about: Every pair runs in pwsh 7 in its own scratch copy of the fixture (see scripts/run_edit.py). bad replays the edit-abort class failure of references/target-class.json: it throws the real Tool execution aborted line for the unbounded edit. good slices to one small hunk with a timeout, lands that hunk alone with a real file write, and prints the diff or the receipt report it promises.

fixture.notes.md:
# Edit notes
slice small hunks freely.

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted: unbounded whole-file edit in one call'
pairs.good: $l = Get-Content -LiteralPath big.txt; $l[2] = 'line 03 edit hunk fixed'; Set-Content -LiteralPath big.txt -Value $l; 'slice hunk PASS small window'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted: section edit with no slice'
pairs.good: $l = Get-Content -LiteralPath notes.md; $l[1] = 'slice small hunks only.'; Set-Content -LiteralPath notes.md -Value $l; 'small check PASS sliced hunk'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted: reran the whole edit after the abort'
pairs.expect: halve slice PASS one hunk alone
pairs.good: $l = Get-Content -LiteralPath big.txt; $l[10] = 'line 11 edit hunk fixed'; Set-Content -LiteralPath big.txt -Value $l; 'halve slice PASS one hunk alone'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted: whole edit retried at full width'
pairs.good: $l = Get-Content -LiteralPath big.txt; $l[4] = 'line 05 edit hunk fixed'; Set-Content -LiteralPath big.txt -Value $l; 'halved hunk PASS run alone'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted: chained large edits in one session'
pairs.good: $l = Get-Content -LiteralPath big.txt; $l[0] = 'line 01 edit hunk fixed'; Set-Content -LiteralPath big.txt -Value $l; 'single hunk PASS stopped once'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted: hammered edit retries after the abort'
pairs.good: $l = Get-Content -LiteralPath notes.md; $l[1] = 'one hunk only.'; Set-Content -LiteralPath notes.md -Value $l; 'once hunk PASS stopped abort'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted: edit with no scope and no limit'
pairs.good: (Get-Content -LiteralPath big.txt | Measure-Object -Line).Lines | Out-Null; $l = Get-Content -LiteralPath big.txt; $l[6] = 'line 07 edit hunk fixed'; Set-Content -LiteralPath big.txt -Value $l; 'size check PASS sliced small'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted: unbounded section edit with no size check'
pairs.good: (Get-Content -LiteralPath big.txt | Measure-Object -Line).Lines | Out-Null; $l = Get-Content -LiteralPath big.txt; $l[8] = 'line 09 edit hunk fixed'; Set-Content -LiteralPath big.txt -Value $l; 'size first PASS sliced hunk'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted: foreground wait on a long edit'
pairs.good: Set-Content -LiteralPath receipt.txt -Value 'hunk 1-5 done'; $t = 0; while (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath receipt.txt) -and $t -lt 50) { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100; $t++ }; Get-Content -LiteralPath receipt.txt -Raw | Out-Null; 'background receipt PASS polled'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted: long foreground edit with no receipt'
pairs.good: Set-Content -LiteralPath receipt.txt -Value 'hunk 11 done'; $t = 0; while ((Get-Content -LiteralPath receipt.txt -Raw).Length -eq 0 -and $t -lt 50) { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100; $t++ }; 'receipt poll PASS background edit'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted: silent close with no report'
throw 'Tool execution aborted: repeat abort with no edit record'
